question: Who among the following Bharatnatyam dancers received the prestigious Natya Kalanidhi award in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chitra Visweswaran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chitra Visweswaran is a renowned Bharatnatyam dancer and choreographer.
 
• She has been honored with several prestigious awards including the Padma Shri in 1992.
 
• Chitra Visweswaran is the founder of the Chidambaram Academy of Performing Arts in Chennai.
 
• In 2021, she was awarded the Natya Kalanidhi award by the Music Academy in Chennai for her contributions to Bharatnatyam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatnatyam**

 
 
• Bharatnatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• This dance form is traditionally performed by women and has its roots in the temples and courts of southern India.
 
• Bharatnatyam performances are usually based on themes from Hindu mythology and spiritual ideas.
 
 
 
• **Natya Kalanidhi Award**
 
 
• The Natya Kalanidhi award is a prestigious honor bestowed by the Music Academy in Chennai.
 
• It is awarded to exceptional artists for their outstanding contributions to the field of dance, particularly Bharatnatyam.
 
• The award is part of the December music and dance festival organized by the Music Academy annually.
 
• Previous recipients of the award include legendary dancers and choreographers who have significantly impacted the classical dance scene in India.
 
 
 
• **Chidambaram Academy of Performing Arts (CAPA)**
 
 
• Founded by Chitra Visweswaran, CAPA is a premier institution dedicated to the teaching and propagation of Bharatnatyam.
 
• Located in Chennai, the academy offers training in classical dance and has produced numerous accomplished dancers.
 
• CAPA also organizes performances, workshops, and festivals to promote classical dance and provide a platform for young dancers.
 
• The academy is known for its rigorous training programs and emphasis on preserving the traditional aspects of Bharatnatyam.
